NGI Zero Commons Fund

The NGI Zero Commons Fund has a total budget of €21.6 million to support free and open source technology for the internet commons.

Calls are open every two months; see the proposal page for the next deadline.

Themes and scope

  • open hardware
  • internet protocols and infrastructure
  • privacy-enhancing technologies
  • search and discovery

Conditions

You can request an amount between 5000 and 50000 euro for a first proposal.

All project outcomes must be published under a free and open source licence.

Projects must have a clear European dimension.
